detail.longDescription: I want to make a graph with 3 mains rows, all divided into 2 sub-rows, themselves divided in columns. Main rows have to be separated by a larger space than sub-rows, in order for a title to be added. However, the layout breaks when adding columns. Here is the code for building the layout with only main rows and sub-rows (F1), and then adding columns (F2). I have also included the results of both functions below. import matplotlib.pyplot as plt nrows = 3 nSubrows = 2 ncolsList = [3, 2] figSizeIN = [12, 12] def F1(): fig = plt.figure(figsize = figSizeIN) gridspec = fig.add_gridspec(nrows = nrows, ncols = 1, left = 0, right = 1, bottom = 0, top = 1) for gs in gridspec: subfig = fig.add_subfigure(gs) subgridspec = subfig.add_gridspec(nrows = nSubrows, ncols = 1, hspace = 0.1, left = 0, right = 1, bottom = 0, top = 0.8) for subsubfigInc, subGs in enumerate(subgridspec): subfig.add_subplot(subGs) if subsubfigInc == 0: subfig.suptitle('title', y = 0.9, verticalalignment = 'top', zorder = 3) def F2(): fig = plt.figure(figsize = figSizeIN) gridspec = fig.add_gridspec(nrows = nrows, ncols = 1, left = 0, right = 1, bottom = 0, top = 1) for gs in gridspec: subfig = fig.add_subfigure(gs) subgridspec = subfig.add_gridspec(nrows = nSubrows, ncols = 1, hspace = 0.1, left = 0, right = 1, bottom = 0, top = 0.8) for subsubfigInc, subGs in enumerate(subgridspec): subsubfig = subfig.add_subfigure(subGs) ncols = ncolsList[subsubfigInc] subsubgridspec = subsubfig.add_gridspec(nrows = 1, ncols = ncols, wspace = 0, hspace = 0, left = 0, right = 1, bottom = 0, top = 0.9) for subsubGs in subsubgridspec: subsubfig.add_subplot(subsubGs) if subsubfigInc == 0: subfig.suptitle('title', y = 0.9, verticalalignment = 'top', zorder = 3) F1() F2()
